meaning.zh:
“别跟我说” 或 “我不想听”。

这个短语起源于上世纪90年代的美国俚语，通常是作为一种表示不耐烦或不愿意听某人说话的手势动作。在说这句话时，人们会将手掌向外平伸，表示拒绝交流和不满。随着时间的推移，这个短语渐渐成为一种口头表达，用来表示某人对他人的话语不感兴趣且不愿意听。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the slang of the 1990s in the United States, typically accompanied by a hand gesture with the palm facing outward, symbolizing a refusal to listen or impatience. Over time, "Talk to the hand" became a verbal expression used to indicate that someone is uninterested and does not want to hear what the other person is saying.

lines.en: When he started arguing, she just said, "Talk to the hand."
lines.zh: 当他开始争论时，她只说了一句，“别跟我说。”

lines.en: If you're going to complain again, just talk to the hand.
lines.zh: 如果你又要抱怨，那就别跟我说。

lines.en: I tried to explain, but he just told me, "Talk to the hand."
lines.zh: 我试图解释，但他只是对我说，“我不想听。”
